stem.text: The photomicrograph shows cells from a human blood smear.

stem.alt: Photomicrograph of a white blood cell surrounded by red blood cells, labelled neutrophil, with a line PQ across the cell.

stem.text: Which calculation shows a correct method to calculate the actual diameter of the neutrophil shown in the photomicrograph in micrometres ($\mu$m)?

A.latex: \dfrac{\text{length of line PQ in mm} \times 1000}{\text{magnification of photomicrograph}}

B.latex: \dfrac{\text{length of line PQ in mm} \times 10\,000}{\text{magnification of photomicrograph}}

C.latex: \dfrac{\text{magnification of photomicrograph}}{\text{length of line PQ in mm} \times 1000}

D.latex: \dfrac{\text{magnification of photomicrograph}}{\text{length of line PQ in mm} \times 10\,000}
